farmersdelight.configuration.cuttingBoar: How much (in decimal percentage) should each level of Fortune increase th' odds of obtaining rare results on th' Cutting Board? Set to 0.0 to disable.
farmersdelight.configuration.debug.toolt: Arrr! §lWarning:§r This section is not meant for standard gameplay.
farmersdelight.configuration.defaultToma: Arrr! Which rope should Tomato Vines leave behind when broken?
farmersdelight.configuration.enableComfo: If enabled, a scrolling overlay will be shown over th' health meter when th' player has th' Comfort effect.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableCooki: If enabled, th' Cookin' Pot will provide a Recipe Book on its interface, similar to th' one on Crafting Tables and Furnaces.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableCutti: If enabled, th' Dispenser will be able to operate a Cutting Board in front of itself, using stored items as cutting tools.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableFarme: Arrr! If enabled, Novice and Apprentice Farmer villagers will have a chance to buy crops from this mod.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableFoodE: If enabled, grub items will display tooltips showing which effects they grant when eaten, if any. Applies to foods from both Minecraft and this mod.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableNouri: If enabled, a gilded overlay will be shown over th' grub meter when th' player has th' Nourishment effect.
farmersdelight.configuration.enablePumpk: Arrr! Sneak to Place Pumpkin Pie
If enabled, Pumpkin Pie will require th' user to sneak to place it down as a block.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableRabbi: If enabled, Rabbit Stew will be given improved grub stats, to match its crafting cost.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableRopeR: If enabled, players will be able to reel back rope, bottom to top, when sneak-using wi' an empty hand on them.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableStack: If enabled, any Bowlfooditem in th' following list will become stackable to 16, much like Farmer's Delight's meals.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableTomat:
Tomato crops hanging on rope will force-place a Rope block when broken. Due to technical limitations, this affects things such as commands, making them fail to 'setblock' this block on th' first attempt.

Disable this if this block is preventing ye from editing a region in creative or wi' commands. For normal gameplay, I recommend leaving this enabled.
Arrr! Tomato Vine Climbs Tagged Ropes

If enabled, tomato crops will be able to climb any rope tagged as farmersdelight:ropes. If disabled, this will be restricted to this mod's rope only.

§lBeware: this will convert these blocks into th' block specified in defaultTomatoVineRope.§r
farmersdelight.configuration.enableVanil: Arrr! If enabled, storage crates (3x3) for vanilla crops (similar to Quark and Thermal Cultivation) will become craftable.
Arrr! If enabled, soups and stews from Minecraft will grant Nourishment when eaten, similar to meals from this mod.
farmersdelight.configuration.enableWande: If enabled, th' Wandering Trader will have a chance to sell seeds and plantables from this mod.
farmersdelight.configuration.generateFDC: If enabled, new loot pools will be added to chest loot across th' game, containing items from this mod (ropes, crops, tools etc).
Arrr! Generate Mod Crops on Village Farms
Arrr! If enabled, crops from Farmer's Delight will sometimes replace standard crops in village farm plots.
farmersdelight.configuration.generateVil: Arrr! If enabled, Compost Heaps (structures containing Organic Compost piles) will sometimes generate across Villages.
farmersdelight.configuration.richSoilBoo: Th' chance (in decimal percentage) of Rich Soil providing a bone meal boost to a crop planted on it. Set to 0.0 to disable.
farmersdelight.configuration.soupItemLis: List of targeted grub items. They must extend th' Bowlfooditem class in code to be affected. Defaults to vanilla soups and stews.
